title: Guests
explanation: Daily recorded hotel guests for a nationality, including arrivals and continuing stays. Summing daily records produces the recorded guest-day proxy used here.
limitations: The dictionary does not establish that each record is an occupied overnight guest-night or a unique person. Later Guests labels are withheld.

title: New Arrivals
explanation: Hotel check-ins recorded on a date. Complete daily counts are summed to the monthly model target.
limitations: This is hotel check-ins, not all international visitors. The dictionary describes it as a subset of Guests; isolated inconsistent records retain quality flags.

title: Same-Day Guests
explanation: Guests who visit and depart on the same day without an overnight stay.
limitations: The asterisk can mean zero, suppressed or not applicable. It remains missing. The dictionary does not establish a universal subtraction rule from Guests.

title: Total Seats
explanation: Recorded seat capacity across cabin classes, aggregated to month and route group.
limitations: A recorded group does not establish complete flight coverage. Capacity does not directly identify hotel arrivals.

title: Total PAX
explanation: Recorded passengers including P2P, transfer and transit; the infant-excluding field is separate.
limitations: It includes people who do not terminate their journey in Abu Dhabi. Some recorded passenger counts exceed seats.

title: P2P
explanation: Point-to-point passengers whose recorded journey terminates at Abu Dhabi. The model uses monthly P2P from the departure country matching the hotel nationality name.
limitations: Departure country does not identify passport nationality, hotel use, residence or a causal conversion rate.

title: Transfer
explanation: Passengers arriving on a route and transferring to another flight at Abu Dhabi, involving a change of aircraft or flight number.
limitations: Transfer passengers are not automatically hotel guests or destination visitors.

title: Transit
explanation: Passengers in transit through Abu Dhabi; the dictionary typically describes remaining on the same aircraft or a simpler connection.
limitations: Do not assume transit passengers stay in hotels.

title: Load Factor
explanation: Total PAX divided by Total Seats, displayed as a percentage. Scenario overrides preserve reference P2P share unless an added route has an explicit share assumption.
limitations: Historical values above 100 percent remain flagged. Planning overrides range from zero to 100 percent; they are assumptions.

title: Missing-value rules
explanation: Missing and ambiguous asterisk values stay null. Partial available sums are retained in separate observed fields; zero is used only for an actual recorded zero or an explicitly assumed removed route.
limitations: Never replace null with zero in charts, scores or model inputs. Intentional withholding differs from missing measurements.

title: Complete-month rules
explanation: A hotel metric is complete only when every calendar day has that metric observed. Guests, New Arrivals and Same-Day Guests have separate coverage tests.
limitations: Flight completeness covers recorded contributing rows, not an unknown expected flight roster. Incomplete hotel months remain in exports but are excluded from complete-target fitting and scores.

title: Seasonality
explanation: The dashboard index compares a complete month's daily mean with the same nationality and metric's full-year daily mean. An index of 100 represents that year's daily average.
limitations: Indices require all twelve complete months. They describe the recorded year and can reflect trends or unusual events. The model learns calendar-month indicators separately.

title: Adjusted correlation
explanation: Compare hotel arrivals and departure-country P2P after removing their fitted calendar-month patterns, linear trends and association with airport P2P excluding that country. Correlate the remaining residuals.
limitations: At least 24 paired months and ten residual degrees of freedom are required. Adjustment cannot prove a route, nationality flow or causal effect; many tested pairs may look strong by chance.

title: Market mapping
explanation: The mapping file screens associations across hotel nationalities and departure countries. The fitted regression uses matching country names rather than selected alternatives.
limitations: Full-history exploratory correlations include the final evaluation dates. They are not validated travel flows or training-only selected predictors.

title: Historical support
explanation: Support fields track training months, repeated calendar combinations, passenger variation, input ranges and whether a local guest-day factor can be fitted.
limitations: These checks describe available evidence, not statistical confidence or causal validity. Twelve nationalities lack a matching passenger response.

title: WMAPE
explanation: Sum absolute prediction errors, divide by the sum of observed targets, and multiply by 100. Lower is better; the main comparisons use identical eligible observations.
limitations: It is not the share of correct predictions. Large-volume markets dominate; inspect market and season scores too. It is undefined when total actual demand is zero.

title: Final model comparison
explanation: On January 2025 to February 2026, arrival WMAPE is 25.52 percent for the reference-driven regression and 22.63 percent for the seasonal benchmark. Actual-P2P conditional prediction scores 23.31 percent.
limitations: The regression did not beat the benchmark. Guest-day scores cover only January to July 2025. These test outcomes have now been used for evaluation.

title: Guest-day conversion
explanation: Multiply predicted check-ins by a historical Guests-to-New-Arrivals ratio on jointly complete training months. Forty-two markets use local factors and three use the pooled fallback.
limitations: This produces recorded guest-day proxies, not verified occupied guest nights or measured length of stay. It does not allocate stays across month boundaries.

title: Scenario calculation
explanation: Apply explicit aviation controls to the 2024 monthly reference, derive changed P2P and run the frozen regression for baseline and scenario. Aggregate monthly outputs over the requested period.
limitations: This estimates a predictive response under declared assumptions. It does not establish the causal hotel effect of changing flights. The origin stays at December 2024 and does not auto-refresh.

title: Bounds and sensitivity
explanation: Bounds are null because intervals were not calibrated. Named sensitivity cases change passenger and conversion assumptions in both baseline and scenario.
limitations: Lower and higher assumption cases are not confidence intervals or probability bounds.
